$comment: Usage text for every token in DESIGN.md. Source of the Usage column; `npm run design:build` merges it with the token values. Rules are tried in order and the first `match` (a regex on the token name) wins. `$1`, `$2` insert capture groups; `{intent:1}` inserts labels.intent[capture 1]. `source`: `code` = written from how src/components uses the token; `name` = drafted from the token name only, shown as a draft in DESIGN.md until the team confirms it (then change it to `team`).

color.usage: Page canvas behind all content (grey in light). Never for cards or panels: use `static-fill-container`.
Full-width content sections placed directly on the page canvas. Cards use `static-fill-container`.
Cards and boxed panels (`Card`). Never for the page canvas.
Floating layers: modals, menus, select lists, popovers. Never for in-page cards.
Quiet neutral fill on any surface: icon tiles, skeleton blocks, the unchecked Switch track.
Neutral tint one step stronger than `static-fill-alpha-subtle`: hover on neutral rows and list items.
Strongest neutral tint: pressed or selected neutral rows and list items.
Background of form fields and checkboxes (`Input`, `Select`, `Checkbox`).
Background of bordered buttons and bordered tags.
Field or bordered-control background on an inverse surface.
Inverse surface (dark in the light theme): tooltips, code blocks.
The `static-fill-$1` role inside an inverse surface.
The `static-fill-alpha-$1` role inside an inverse surface.
Dimmed backdrop behind modals.
Hairline outline inside `shadow-elevation-medium`. Not used as a class on its own.
Colour of the focus ring. Use it through `shadow-focus-base`, not as a class.
Default border and divider: cards, table rows, section separators.
Lighter divider inside a section, between items that already share a container.
Emphasised neutral border, stronger than `static-stroke-base`.
The `static-stroke-$1` role on an inverse surface.
Headings, key values, emphasised labels.
Body text and default labels.
Secondary text: descriptions, helper text, captions, table metadata. Never for disabled states: use the `*-disabled` text token of the control.
The `static-text-$1` role on an inverse surface (e.g. `Tooltip`).
Background of a filled {intent:1} button or control, {state:2}. Text on it: `dynamic-text-on$1-$2`.
Background of a ghost {intent:1} button or control, {state:2} (transparent at rest). Text: `dynamic-text-$1-*`.
Tinted background of a selected or checked {intent:1} control {state:2} (e.g. the `Switch` track).
Tinted background of a selected or checked {intent:1} control {state:2}.
Background of a filled tertiary control {state:1}. No component uses tertiary yet.
Ghost or selected background of a tertiary control {state:1}. No component uses tertiary yet.
Border of a bordered (`appearance="border"`) {intent:1} button {state:2}.
Emphasised {intent:1} border of form fields and checkboxes {state:2}: focus and checked (primary), error (danger), resting field border (secondary).
Emphasised {intent:1} border of form fields {state:2}.
Text and icons on a filled `dynamic-fill-$1-*` background, {state:2}.
Text and icons of bordered and ghost {intent:1} buttons, {state:2}.
Tinted background for {status:1}: low-emphasis `Badge`, `Alert`. Text on it: `semantic-text-onsubtle-$1`.
Solid background for {status:1}: high-emphasis `Toast` and `Badge`. Text on it: `semantic-text-oninverse-$1`.
Border of an element tinted for {status:1} (bordered `Tag`).
Text and icons that state {status:1} on a regular surface: the Alert icon and a field's helper text in that state.
Text on `semantic-fill-$1` (low-emphasis Badge, Alert text).
Text on `semantic-fill-inverse-$1` (high-emphasis Toast and Badge).
`Tag` category colour $1, $2 emphasis. Categories only, never status: status uses `semantic-*`.
Border of a bordered `Tag` in category colour $1.
Text on `non-semantic-fill-$1-$2`.

spacing.usage: Icon to label inside a control; label to value in a stacked pair.
Between controls in a group or toolbar; title to description.
Tight vertical stacks: icon row to text block, list item internals.
Card header padding; between a row's text and its control; mobile page gutter.
Between form fields; between blocks inside a card.
Card content padding; page side padding from `sm`; grid gap between cards.
Page top and bottom padding; empty-state padding.
Gap scale step $1. Use it only to match a Figma spacing value; the steps with a usage above cover layouts.

size.usage: Icons inside small and medium controls and badges.
Icons inside medium and large buttons; alert icons.
Icon tiles and avatars in lists (40px).
Largest fixed width (160px), e.g. a select's minimum width. Wider: use `max-w-*` or a grid.

forms.usage: Height of a `$1` control (`h-forms-$1`). Match the component's `size` prop.
Inner height of a `$1` control part (checkbox box, switch thumb). Used inside components only.
